checkRuns.command: bun run build 2>&1 | tail -5; (PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 3 for p in / /books /books/dracula /books/x /nope; do echo "== $p"; curl -s -o /tmp/o -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:4701$p; grep -o '[^<]*\|aria-current="page"[^>]*>[^<]*' /tmp/o; done curl -s localhost:4701/ | grep -o '<ol.*</ol>' curl -s -i -X POST localhost:4701/contact -H 'Origin: http://localhost:4701' -d 'name=Al&email=bad&message=short' | grep -iE "HTTP|error|value=|textarea" curl -s -X POST localhost:4701/contact -H 'Origin: http://localhost:4701' -d 'name=Al&email=a@b.co&message=long enough message here ok' | grep -o 'Thanks[^<]*'

python3 - <<'E'
p='src/routes/_layout.kay'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("const section = ctx.url.pathname.split('/')[1]\n","""import { books } from '../content.config'

const [, first, second] = ctx.url.pathname.replace(/\\/+$/, '').split('/')
const known = first !== 'books' || second === undefined || await books.get(second) !== undefined
const section = known ? first : undefined
""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
pkill -f "kay start"; bun run fmt >/dev/null 2>&1; bun run check | tail -5; bun run build 2>&1 | grep -i error
(PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 3
curl -s localhost:4701/books/x | grep -c 'aria-current'; curl -s localhost:4701/books/dracula | grep -c 'aria-current'
A=/_kay/action/src/routes/contact.kay/send
curl -s -i -X POST localhost:4701$A -H 'Origin: http://localhost:4701' -d 'name=Al&email=bad&message=short' | grep -iE "^HTTP|error|value=|textarea"
curl -s -X POST localhost:4701$A -H 'Origin: http://localhost:4701' -d 'name=Al&email=a@b.co&message=long enough message here ok' | grep -o 'Thanks[^<]*'
head -8 src/routes/_layout.kay; bun run check | tail -5; bun run build 2>&1 | grep -i error; ss -ltnp | grep 4701
